```{r Libraries}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)
library(DBI)
source("useful-functions.R")

```

```{r Paths to data}
#| include: false

# Database parameters -----------------------------------------------------

# This is the path to the ECM reporting database. In order to connect to this
# database, you must be connected to the ESDC VPN. You must also set the
# username/password secrets ahead of time. Manage your secrets with:

# keyring::key_set("ECM-DB-WRITE-USER")  # Enter the DB username
# keyring::key_set("ECM-DB-WRITE-PASS")  # Enter the DB password

con <- dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  Driver = "SQL Server",
  Server = "MLCNESD4150.hrdc-drhc.net\\MLDB16SA01",
  Database = "VendorData",
  UID = keyring::key_get("ECM-DB-ADMIN-USER"),
  PWD = keyring::key_get("ECM-DB-ADMIN-PASS"),
)

gc_departments <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "gc_departments") %>%
  mutate(department = paste0(acronym_en, " / ", acronym_fr)) %>%
  select(gcid_fk = id, department)

historical_costs <- dbReadTable(con, "costs_historical") %>%
  left_join(gc_departments, by = "gcid_fk")

forecasts <- dbReadTable(con, "costs_forecast") %>%
  left_join(gc_departments, by = "gcid_fk")


mou_values <- read_csv("data/mou_values.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

```

Report generated: **`r format(Sys.Date(), "%b %d, %Y")`**

# About Data

Here's some words about the data.

# Departments 
```{r Procedurally generate a tab for each department, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

# Pull departments in order of most expensive to least expensive
# Generally, folks are interested in the big ticket items, and don't want to
# scroll all the way to the bottom.

departments <- sort(unique(historical_costs$department))

for (this_department in departments) {
  
  res <- knitr::knit_child("by-department.Qmd", quiet = TRUE)
  cat(res, sep = "\n")
  
}
```
